args.sql:
SELECT 
    s.signalregistry AS "Signal ID",
    sc.sigclasstype AS "Signal Type",
    ROUND(CAST((1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000)) * s.sigdursec / (1 + s.doppshifthz / 1000) AS numeric), 4) AS "SSM",
    sd.freqstab || ', ' || sd.phasestab || ', ' || sd.sigintegrity AS "Combined Stability Report",
    CASE 
        WHEN (1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000)) * s.sigdursec / (1 + s.doppshifthz / 1000) > 0.8 
             AND sc.entropyval BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8 
             AND s.modindex > 0.5 
        THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected'
        WHEN (1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000)) * s.sigdursec / (1 + s.doppshifthz / 1000) > 0.6 
             AND sc.entropyval BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9 
        THEN 'Potential Information Pattern'
        ELSE 'No Clear Pattern'
    END AS "CIP Classification Label"
FROM signals s
JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref
JOIN signaldynamics sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
LIMIT 3
